scheme_name: Scheme of Assistance for Common Environment Infrastructure: Common Boiler Project by SPV Constituted by Minimum 10 MSMEs
other_conditions: The project must be promoted by an SPV comprising at least 10 MSMEs that use steam in their operations.
Each MSME in the SPV must have an independent boiler at its current premises.
The new boiler must be energy‑efficient, as certified by the Office of the Boiler Inspector.
The SPV must obtain all statutory permissions for boiler operation and steam distribution.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to 35% of project cost for solid‑fuel boilers and up to 50% for cleaner‑fuel boilers, with a maximum cap of ₹2,00,00,000.
